experiment: Separate long-form Saudi LoRA experiment v3; never overwrite or relabel approved v2
references: 80 AI-authored and assistant-curated situations, not human-approved. Drafts outside the selected 80 excluded. No model-generated result is presented as a training reference.
writing_views: Conversational and clear for all cases; professional additionally for work/university/customer cases. Same meaning retained across tags.
policy: policy.json; clean instruction without a list of stock answer phrases or in-context examples
initialization: Frozen base, no warm start from pilot/v2/earlier experimental adapters
development: Four already exposed dev.json cases only. Compare both epoch checkpoints with the same new policy, greedy decoding, thinking disabled, max_tokens 256, no dialect replacements. Preserve untouched decoded text alongside conservative format-cleaned text; judge decoded text. Select by strict sendability, earlier epoch on ties. Require all four development cases strictly sendable before opening the unused fresh test.
paired_comparison: Base, preserved pilot, approved v2 and selected v3 checkpoint use the identical new policy, base, sampler and token limit. This compares the combined adapted systems, not an isolated causal effect of one data or hyperparameter change.
strict_pass: Every listed meaning requirement, no invented fact/excuse/promise, correct roles/genders, natural Saudi text sendable without factual or grammatical repair. Minor orthography alone does not fail.
reviewer: Assistant assessment; independent human Saudi Arabic review remains pending
failure_policy: Record real losses, outputs and unsuccessful cases. Preserve all existing models and do not promote a failed candidate. No paid resources or local voice secret transfer.
